question: Contá los ensayos de linfoma con fecha de inicio en 2020 o después que incluyen rituximab.

attempts.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
JOIN linking.trial_drug td ON td.nct_id = s.nct_id
JOIN linking.drug d ON d.chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id AND d.pref_name = 'RITUXIMAB'
WHERE s.start_date >= DATE '2020-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM linking.trial_condition tc
  JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
  JOIN mesh.descriptor md ON md.id = a.ancestor_id AND md.label = 'Lymphoma'
  WHERE tc.nct_id = s.nct_id)
